description: Test script for retrieving the software version installed on a CPE device using the pam_GetParameterValues API. It configures the test environment, invokes the specific API, checks the result, and displays the outcome.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: Provides testing utilities for remote script execution and component interaction.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for a specified test component.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds parameters to the test step for the API call.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the configured test case and performs the API call.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result status ('SUCCESS' or 'FAILURE') after test execution.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about the test execution result.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Sets the final status ('SUCCESS' or 'FAILURE') of the test step.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with the target device's IP, port, and name.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Checks if the test module was loaded successfully.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the status after attempting to load the test module.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the specified test module after test completion.
